action_data.label_rule: Fixed seeded choice among all legal distance-decreasing neighbors; evaluation accepts every such neighbor.

report_replay.selection: Cover each node and report role once, then fill to the action-example count by seeded permutation.

training.compute_matching: Per graph, both conditions see the same 5N samples per epoch and 10 epochs. Action supervision replaces half of the report-only control presentations.

evaluation.primary_comparison: report_plus_action versus equal-budget report_continuation on each graph's unchanged test split
